name: archer-irm-api
description: Skill for working with the Archer IRM (formerly RSA Archer) platform APIs: RESTful Platform API, V2 API (Personal Access Tokens, DeletedContent), Content API (OData), Data Gateway, SOAP Web Services API and NGRX. Includes an OpenAPI 3.1 spec, endpoint and field-type references, a full documentation snapshot, and dependency-free Python REST and SOAP clients.
